name: GitHub Label-Driven Kanban Pipeline (Aider + Ollama + Qdrant + Human Gate)

parameters.command:
=docker exec -i -u 1000 kanban-runner bash -s << 'ENDOFSCRIPT'
set -e
cd /workspace

export GH_TOKEN="{{ $env.GITHUB_TOKEN }}"

# Auto-swap label to agent:in-progress
gh issue edit {{ $json.issueNumber }} --repo conarwelsh/sous.tools --remove-label "agent:ready" --add-label "agent:in-progress" 2>/dev/null || true

python3 scripts/populate_qdrant.py 2>/dev/null || true

git fetch origin 2>/dev/null || true
git checkout issue-{{ $json.issueNumber }} 2>/dev/null || git checkout -b issue-{{ $json.issueNumber }}

cat << 'EOF_AIDER_PROMPT' > /workspace/.aider.prompt.txt
[TASK]: {{ $json.issueTitle }}.
[DETAILS]: {{ $json.issueBody }}
[RECENT CONVERSATION]: {{ $json.last2Comments }}

Rules:
1. Read AGENTS.md for architectural constraints.
2. Query Qdrant MCP FIRST.
3. Keep changes minimal and focused.
4. If blocked, output EXACTLY: NEEDS_INPUT: <question> and stop immediately.
EOF_AIDER_PROMPT

aider \
  --model openai/coder \
  --openai-api-base http://litellm:4000/v1 \
  --openai-api-key sk-1234 \
  --edit-format diff \
  --no-auto-commits \
  --yes \
  --message-file /workspace/.aider.prompt.txt

TEST_OUTPUT=$(pnpm turbo typecheck 2>&1 && pnpm turbo lint 2>&1 && INFISICAL_MOCK=true pnpm turbo test 2>&1)

git add .
git commit -m "feat(issue-{{ $json.issueNumber }}): {{ $json.issueTitle }}" || true
git push origin issue-{{ $json.issueNumber }}

PR_URL=$(gh pr create \
  --repo conarwelsh/sous.tools \
  --base main \
  --head issue-{{ $json.issueNumber }} \
  --title "feat(#{{ $json.issueNumber }}): {{ $json.issueTitle }}" \
  --body "Resolves #{{ $json.issueNumber }}

## Test Results
\`\`\`
${TEST_OUTPUT}
\`\`\`" 2>/dev/null || gh pr view issue-{{ $json.issueNumber }} --repo conarwelsh/sous.tools --json url -q .url)

python3 scripts/populate_qdrant.py 2>/dev/null || true
echo "PR: $PR_URL"
ENDOFSCRIPT

set -e

export GH_TOKEN="{{ $env.GITHUB_TOKEN }}"

git fetch origin 2>/dev/null || true
git checkout issue-{{ $json.issueNumber }} 2>/dev/null || git checkout -b issue-{{ $json.issueNumber }}

cat << 'EOF_AIDER_PROMPT' > /workspace/.aider.prompt.txt
[HUMAN FEEDBACK]: {{ $json.commentBody }}
[RECENT CONVERSATION]: {{ $json.last2Comments }}

Complete task: {{ $json.issueTitle }}
EOF_AIDER_PROMPT

aider \
  --model openai/coder \
  --openai-api-base http://litellm:4000/v1 \
  --openai-api-key sk-1234 \
  --edit-format diff \
  --no-auto-commits \
  --yes \
  --message-file /workspace/.aider.prompt.txt

TEST_OUTPUT=$(pnpm turbo typecheck 2>&1 && pnpm turbo lint 2>&1 && INFISICAL_MOCK=true pnpm turbo test 2>&1)

git add . && git commit -m "fix(issue-{{ $json.issueNumber }}): apply human feedback" || true
git push origin issue-{{ $json.issueNumber }}

PR_URL=$(gh pr view issue-{{ $json.issueNumber }} --repo conarwelsh/sous.tools --json url -q .url 2>/dev/null || gh pr create --repo conarwelsh/sous.tools --base main --head issue-{{ $json.issueNumber }} --title "fix(#{{ $json.issueNumber }}): {{ $json.issueTitle }}" --body "Resolves #{{ $json.issueNumber }}

## Test Results
\`\`\`
${TEST_OUTPUT}
\`\`\`")

python3 scripts/populate_qdrant.py 2>/dev/null || true
echo "PR: $PR_URL"
ENDOFSCRIPT

parameters.name: body

parameters.command:
=docker exec -i -u 1000 kanban-runner bash -s << 'ENDOFSCRIPT'
set -e
cd /workspace

export GH_TOKEN="{{ $env.GITHUB_TOKEN }}"

git checkout main
git pull origin main

gh pr merge issue-{{ $json.issueNumber }} --repo conarwelsh/sous.tools --merge --delete-branch 2>/dev/null || true
gh issue edit {{ $json.issueNumber }} --repo conarwelsh/sous.tools --remove-label "agent:in-progress" --remove-label "agent:review" --add-label "Done" 2>/dev/null || true

python3 scripts/populate_qdrant.py 2>/dev/null || true
echo "Merged #{{ $json.issueNumber }}"
ENDOFSCRIPT
